tasks.label: Serve (Local)
tasks.detail: Build the site and serve it at http://localhost:8080 with live reload

tasks.label: Commit & Push
tasks.detail: Stage all changes, commit with a message, and push to GitHub
tasks.command: git add -A && git status --short && if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo 'Nothing new to commit.'; else git commit -m "$COMMIT_MSG"; fi && echo 'Pulling latest changes from GitHub...' && { git pull --rebase origin "$(git branch --show-current)" || { echo 'Pull stopped on a conflict: nothing was pushed. Resolve the conflict and run git rebase --continue, or undo the pull with git rebase --abort.'; false; }; } && git push -u origin HEAD

tasks.label: Pull from GitHub
tasks.detail: Update local files from GitHub (keeps your local changes)
tasks.command: old=$(git rev-parse HEAD) && echo 'Pulling latest changes from GitHub...' && { git pull --rebase --autostash origin "$(git branch --show-current)" || { echo 'Pull stopped on a conflict. Resolve it and run git rebase --continue, or undo with git rebase --abort.'; false; }; } && { git diff --quiet "$old" HEAD -- package-lock.json || { echo 'Dependencies changed on GitHub: reinstalling...' && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; }; } && { [ "$old" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" ] && echo 'Already up to date with GitHub.' || { echo 'New from GitHub:' && git log --oneline --no-decorate "$old"..HEAD | sed 's/^/  /'; }; }
